Title: 4WD jeep tour into the valleys
Details: Off-the-beaten-path countryside day idea: unpaved roads, remote villages, hidden waterfall, Byzantine church frescoes, Roman ruins, Ottoman bridge/communist monument style stops. Ask locally.

Title: Ali Pasha Bridge hike
Details: Short but steep/rocky hike to the 19th-century aqueduct remnant. Article says about 30-40 minutes; go early for heat and note unfenced heights.

Title: Bazaar Mosque
Details: Quick old-town mosque stop. Article notes weekdays 9:00 AM - 4:30 PM and free admission; dress conservatively and avoid prayer times.

Title: Blue Eye spring stop
Details: Natural spring about an hour from Gjirokastër and on the way toward Sarandë. Pretty but can be crowded; swimming is not allowed to protect the spring.

Title: Cold War Tunnel
Details: Eerie bunker/tunnel tour from the Hoxha era. Article notes hourly tours, about 30 minutes, daily 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, 200 lekë; bring a layer because it is chilly inside.

Title: Gjirokastër Castle
Details: Core Gjirokastër stop. Go early if warm. Castle views over the old stone houses and Drino valley; article notes daily 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM and 400 lekë admission.

Title: Gjirokastër Castle museums
Details: Add-on museum stops inside/near the castle: Gjirokastër Museum for city history and Arms Museum for wartime artifacts. Article notes 200 lekë each.

Title: Gjirokastër Old Town and Bazaar walk
Details: Wander the UNESCO old town, cobbled streets, cafes, and bazaar. Best especially around golden hour/evening when the streets light up.

Title: Gjirokastër cooking class
Details: Local culinary class idea focused on Albanian/Gjirokastër specialties like qifqi, shapkat, and japrak; look for local or vegetarian options with raki.

Title: Ismail Kadare House
Details: Literary/cultural stop at the childhood home of Albania’s major writer, with stone-roof architecture and original family/personal objects.

Title: Kujtimi Restaurant
Details: More refined but still local. Good for a slightly elevated dinner and more composed regional plates.

Title: Përmet day trip: Vjosa rafting or Langarica Canyon
Details: Nature day trip about an hour from Gjirokastër. Options include accessible Vjosa rafting, Langarica Canyon hike, and thermal baths if pairing adventure with chill time.

Title: Skenduli House
Details: Ottoman-era house museum from the 1700s; good architecture stop for fireplaces, rooms, stone/wood details, and family-guided context. Article notes daily 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM and 300 lekë admission.

Title: Taverna Tradicionale Kardhashi
Details: Traditional regional cooking in Gjirokastër. Order qifqi, lamb in yogurt, and simple local house wine.
